status: source-design-only; no generated inputs or evaluator results exist yet
randomness: SHA256 counter stream over UTF8 JSON array [seed,model,family,candidate,draw]; no platform random module or current time
executionGates: Actual original smoke, exact 69 ID boundaries and independent review must succeed before remote generation. The supplied smoke comparison receipt is byte-bound; its flags do not authenticate the reviewer.

Generation is a separate stage with neither checker imported. Freeze original JSONL, every input SHA, shape SHA, generator/contract SHA, counts and generation errors before any actual expansion evaluator starts.

The evaluator requires the frozen dataset manifest and preserves all first results. A failed adapter disposition, unknown, timeout or mismatch is retained and never replaced with a new generated history.

Do not run the current small-smoke main/expectation wrapper as the bulk evaluator: its whole-file node budget and fixed theoretical truth fields are smoke-specific. A separate reviewed streaming evaluator is required after smoke acceptance.

sharedRange.transactions: 2..6 committed transactions, one connection per transaction; all begin before data operations, no SQL/scopes/unknown outcomes
sharedRange.register: Exactly one write per key, authentic predecessor is captured initial identity. Prefix reads observe initial identities. Suffix reads choose original initial or already observed writer identity, including repeated reads and own-read inconsistencies as real anomaly candidates.
sharedRange.list: Initially empty lists, 2..8 globally unique actual append IDs. Prefix reads are empty. Suffix reads use only already observed original append IDs on the same key, with exact string payload; subset/order/duplicate observations remain raw candidates, not repaired.
sharedRange.businessValues: Fixed repeated values and distinct append identities; no payload is replaced to make an observation eligible.
sharedRange.unsupported: This generation stage does not invent sources, initial transactions, version orders, transaction-order, RT/SO or predicates. The 15 original smoke cases retain explicit outside/invalid probes separately. Any accidentally outside generated case remains a failed range gate, not a replacement opportunity.

deduplication.exact: SHA256 of UTF8 json.dumps(input,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')), no final newline
deduplication.shape: Per-transaction ordered program with transaction/key identities renamed by declared first occurrence, initial/write/append source identities replaced with producer pointers, payload strings replaced by equality classes. Exclude seq,time,clock labels, arbitrary identity spelling and commit ACK order. Include source identity choices, operation order, list order/duplicates and payload equality. This is explicitly not full program/graph isomorphism.
deduplication.selection: First 200 unseen exact and shape histories in each fixed family, candidate ordinals starting0; reject only representational duplicates. No checker/model output is read. Maximum20000 candidates per family; failure retains partial dataset and a failed generation receipt.
deduplication.independentAudit: A separate reader must recompute canonical input hashes, unique raw bytes and normalized program shapes from the frozen JSONL without importing this generator. D can implement a separately authored audit; source author dedup is not called independent third-party acceptance.

wire.format: UTF8 JSONL, sorted keys, ensure_ascii=True, compact separators and one LF per record

evaluationPolicy.profile: Exact original serializable options; optional register order inference disabled and automatic additional-graph count must remain0
evaluationPolicy.batch: At most50 already frozen inputs per fresh bounded300second JVM;10second upstream cycle-search timeout. Preserve every raw checker result and per-case exception/timeout.
evaluationPolicy.classifications: Count Elle true/false/unknown/execution-error, MoonBit consistent/violation/inconclusive/invalid, adapter eligible/outside/invalid, all timeouts and range failures. Compare true/consistent and false/violation only within the declared complete common scope; unknown is recorded as a coverage difference, never a Boolean agreement.
evaluationPolicy.certificates: Independently verify every returned MoonBit report/certificate. Consistent serial witnesses are checked against original programs, not only by trusting producer flags.
evaluationPolicy.acceptance: All2000 frozen records accounted for; no dropped/replaced failures; actual upstream/source/dependency/runtime bindings; independent dedup and result review; every mismatch explained by an unchanged-input reproduction before claiming common-range agreement. No six-model parity or arbitrary SQL claim.
